title: Murder at Blackwood Manor
subtitle: Solo Test Edition
setting: A storm-locked English manor during a private family dinner.
playerRole: You are a late-arriving dinner guest asked by Inspector Graves to help sort the truth from the table gossip.

characters.name: Margaret Blackwood
characters.seat: Head of the table, opposite the empty chair
characters.secret: She planned to leave Edmund after learning he had hidden a second will.
characters.bio: Elegant, cold, and impossible to rattle. Margaret hated Edmund, but she also hated scandal.

questions.q: Where were you when Lord Blackwood collapsed?
questions.a: At my seat. Ask anyone. I had not left the dining room since the soup was served.
I wanted him humbled. That is not the same thing as dead.
Only that dreadful tonic Dr. Ward kept pressing on him. Edmund trusted doctors more than wives.

characters.name: Clara Blackwood
characters.secret: She forged Edmund's signature on a loan paper but planned to confess after dinner.
characters.bio: Sharp, emotional, and furious at being treated like a decorative heirloom.

questions.q: Why did you argue with your father before dinner?
questions.a: Because he was selling the west wing to pay Victor's debts while pretending I was the embarrassment.
No. I threw wine at the fireplace, not at him. There is a difference.

questions.q: What did you see after dessert?
questions.a: Dr. Ward stood behind Father with her hand near his shoulder. I thought she was steadying him.

characters.name: Victor Hale
characters.secret: His investments were collapsing and Edmund was about to cut him loose.
characters.bio: Smooth, overdressed, and sweating through a smile whenever money is mentioned.

questions.a: Threaten is a vulgar word. He expressed concerns about our partnership. Loudly.

questions.q: You poured brandy after dessert. Did Edmund drink it?
questions.a: He refused. Said brandy fought with the doctor's tonic.

questions.q: Where were you during the blackout?
questions.a: By the sideboard. Thomas was there too. He can confirm I was nowhere near Edmund.

characters.name: Dr. Elise Ward
characters.seat: Close enough to watch every pulse
characters.secret: Edmund discovered she was running illegal trials through her private clinic and planned to expose her at midnight.
characters.bio: Calm, precise, and helpful in a way that makes every answer sound rehearsed.

questions.q: What tonic did you give Lord Blackwood?
questions.a: A harmless digestive preparation. He had a weak stomach and a stronger talent for complaint.

questions.q: Did anyone else handle the tonic?
questions.a: No. Medical preparations are not toys. I kept it in my bag until he requested it.

questions.q: Why was Edmund going to meet you at midnight?
questions.a: He was not. Whoever told you that enjoys drama more than accuracy.

characters.name: Thomas Reed
characters.secret: He found Edmund's old confession about ruining his family but did not act on it.
characters.bio: Quiet, exact, and loyal to the house rather than any one Blackwood.

questions.q: What did you notice during dinner?
questions.a: Dr. Ward replaced the small brown bottle beside Lord Blackwood's plate after the lights flickered.
No. Mr Hale was near me during the blackout, breathing like a guilty furnace.
In this house, sir, truth is usually punished before it is believed.

characters.name: Evelyn Cross
characters.secret: She came to retrieve letters proving Edmund had ruined her career years ago.
characters.bio: Glittering, theatrical, and tired of being remembered as someone else's scandal.

questions.a: Edmund enjoyed summoning ghosts and pretending they were guests.

questions.q: Did you approach Edmund after dessert?
questions.a: Only to tell him he looked awful. I thought it was a kindness.

questions.q: Did you see Dr. Ward's bag?
questions.a: Yes. Under her chair. Locked. Then not locked. I remember because the brass clasp caught the candlelight.

scenes.title: Arrival in the Storm
scenes.body: Rain lashes Blackwood Manor hard enough to blur the windows into silver threads. You arrive late, soaked to the collar, just as dinner moves toward dessert. Lord Edmund Blackwood raises his glass and smiles as if the storm has come by invitation.

scenes.title: The Dinner Table
scenes.body: The table is beautiful and poisonous: silver cutlery, candlelight, untouched smiles. Six guests circle Lord Blackwood like planets around a dying sun. Inspector Graves has not arrived yet. For now, you observe.

scenes.title: Dessert Turns Deadly
scenes.body: The lights flicker. Thunder lands directly over the roof. Lord Blackwood coughs once, grips the tablecloth, and turns a color no living man should wear. Dr. Ward reaches him first. By the time the lamps steady, the host is dead.

scenes.title: Inspector Graves Takes the Room
scenes.body: The bridge road is flooded. No one leaves before dawn. Inspector Graves, stranded nearby by the storm, asks you to help question the guests while he secures the body. Everyone had a motive. Only one had the method.

clues.title: Flooded road
clues.text: No one can leave Blackwood Manor until morning.

clues.title: Digestive tonic
clues.text: Edmund drank a doctor's tonic shortly before he collapsed.

clues.title: Blackout
clues.text: The room went dark for several seconds after dessert.

clues.title: Margaret's alibi
clues.text: Margaret remained seated during the critical moments.

clues.title: Cold marriage
clues.text: Margaret hated Edmund but feared public scandal.

clues.title: West wing sale
clues.text: Clara argued with Edmund about selling part of the estate.

clues.title: Victor's debts
clues.text: Victor's business partnership with Edmund was collapsing.

clues.title: Ward's medical tonic
clues.text: Dr. Ward claims the tonic was harmless and kept in her bag.

clues.title: Bottle switch
clues.text: Thomas saw Dr. Ward replace a small brown bottle after the lights flickered.

clues.title: Evelyn's letters
clues.text: Evelyn came for letters connected to an old scandal.

clues.title: Locked medical vial
clues.text: A locked vial in Dr. Ward's bag contains residue matching the tonic glass.

clues.title: Midnight meeting
clues.text: A note in Edmund's study says: Ward. Midnight. Confession or exposure.

locations.name: Edmund's Study
locations.description: A room of ledgers, old letters, and newer threats.

locations.name: Dr. Ward's Medical Bag
locations.description: Locked in haste beneath her chair.

locations.name: Dining Room Sideboard
locations.description: Brandy, glasses, tonic residue, and Victor's fingerprints everywhere except the tonic bottle.
